cycle.claim_boundary: This certificate concerns only the fixed 17x17 periodic repaired exact map, its unique x-independent fixed point on the fixed conservation leaf, the Q011k--Q011l selected invariant graph, an implicitly defined graph-gauge quadratic jet, registered norm bounds and a finite-radius cubic-defect majorant. It stores no componentwise coefficient array, certifies neither the raw Q011b map nor transfer of Q011e--Q011h coefficients, and proves no continuous-amplitude path, higher-order jet, exact invariant manifold or SSM, smoothness, nonlinear normal attraction, basin, other grid, force, wall boundary or D3Q27. A finite cubic defect is not exact invariance.
